title: Golden Throne and Golden Toilet
text: The Golden Throne grants 100% bonus damage, Resistance V, Regeneration V and Saturation. Voluntary dismount is locked for ten minutes; teleporting away ends the benefits. Mining it or sitting for ten minutes leaves a Golden Toilet and a misty treasure orb.
The toilet permits free dismount and grants 20% bonus damage, Regeneration II and Saturation while seated. Sneak-use it on a Cruise Orb to replace the seat and retain those seated benefits.
